title: This Platform
summary: The institute itself, treated as a long-term product, not just a website.
problem: Most engineers public work is scattered across a resume, a GitHub profile, and a handful of unlinked blog posts, none of which show how the work connects.
vision: A single knowledge system where research, projects, and writing all reference each other, so the body of work compounds instead of accumulating as disconnected artifacts.
currentStatus: Foundation and content system built; content types and the knowledge graph are being populated as real work happens.
futurePlans: Semantic search, a public knowledge graph visualization, and eventually a RAG-based assistant over the whole corpus.

body.raw: Built the way it recommends building things: incrementally, with the architecture decided before the code.
